scope: 36 independent GDN layer commits, HK16/HV48/C10240, capacities 4/6 and all positive accepted counts. Eager host submission to queue completion; no whole-model throughput measurement.
protocol: Shape-local A/B/A/B/A; reset/full fingerprint per arm. Warmup 3x64 rounds, timed 9x128 rounds, one wait per batch. Core4 affinity, ABOVE_NORMAL, profiling disabled, shared exclusive GPU/compiler lock. Frozen gates: adjacent baseline drift<=3%, every shape positive, capacity geometric mean>=1%. Best screen candidate per capacity gets two fresh confirmation processes; cleaned final source independently screened and confirmed twice. No resampling.

preparation.scope: Three predeclared candidates against the adopted fixed-geometry coop32 kernel: native 3D groups; 8-byte aligned uint64 state blocks with float bit casts and an unaligned baseline fallback; their combination. Generic geometry retains the production kernel. Float arithmetic, physical state layout and work-item ownership unchanged.
preparation.rule_before_measurement: Three fixed candidates, no resampling. 85 correctness checks each (the original 71 plus 14 4-byte-only aligned state cases). Shape-local A/B/A/B/A screen. Best eligible per capacity gets two fresh confirmation processes. Each positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift<=3%), positive pooled gain, and capacity geometric mean gain>=1% in screen and confirmation. Eager timing only, no whole-model claim.

preparation.scope: Two new history-transfer candidates against the unchanged fixed-geometry coop32 baseline. Interleave the existing three 16-channel sequences in registers and write the 48 contiguous floats with two blocks. Second candidate also loads the old history in two blocks when n<3. Preserve complete load-before-store ordering, channel ownership, float recurrence and layout; generic geometry uses the baseline helper.
preparation.rule_before_measurement: Two fixed candidates, no resampling. 85 correctness checks each, including 14 4-byte-only aligned state cases. Shape-local A/B/A/B/A screen. Best eligible per capacity gets two fresh confirmation processes. Each positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift<=3%), positive pooled gain, and capacity geometric mean gain>=1% in screen and confirmation. Eager timing only, no whole-model claim.

preparation.scope: Cleaned production implementation of history stores only: HK16/HV48 packs 16 channel triplets into two block stores; generic geometry keeps the existing scatter path. Independently rebuild final source for GDN regression, and compare a name-only-renamed final helper against the unchanged current fixed-geometry baseline. Production source remains staged until all checks pass.
preparation.rule_before_measurement: 85 correctness checks, one shape-local A/B/A/B/A screen and two fresh confirmation processes. No resampling. Every positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift<=3%), positive pooled throughput gain, and capacity geometric mean gain>=1% in screen and confirmation. Also require existing multi-geometry commit-layers/window/selftest regressions. Native audit only after successful final confirmation. No whole-model claim.
